physical_state_in: Annual sustainable harvest quota set by DDBRA
physical_state_out: Issued harvest permits by zone and seasonal access schedule with conditions
primary_transformation: DDBRA permit assessment; zone allocation; EIA; machinery access planning
measurable_output: Permits issued (ha licensed); quota allocation (tonnes); compliance rate
output_unit: ha licensed; tonnes quota; percent compliant
D_parameters: DDBRA Management Plan rules; Biosphere Reserve zoning regulations; Romania Ministry of Environment oversight
C_parameters: Permits issued; quotas allocated per zone; access conditions set; compliance monitored
notes: 42000 ha licensed; 200 kt quota; 140 kt actual harvest (70%); 88% permit compliance; 87500 ha core zone protected

physical_state_in: Standing dead reed culms in permitted harvest zones
physical_state_out: Cut reed bundles or chopped biomass at field margin ready for transport
primary_transformation: Mechanical harvesting (Ladog cutters; amphibious harvesters); bundling; field stacking
typical_time_scale: December-February harvest window; best January-February after frost
measurable_output: Harvested volume (tonnes); harvest efficiency (t/machine-day); ice access days available
D_parameters: Seasonal machinery access permits; ice weight regulations; DDBRA operational conditions; nature protection rules
C_parameters: Harvest volume landed; harvest efficiency; ice access days utilised; labour engaged
notes: 140 kt/yr; 65 machines; 12 t/machine-day; 38 ice-access days (declining 1.8 days/yr); 85% mechanical

physical_state_in: Cut reed at field margin or collection point
physical_state_out: Graded bundled thatching reed or chopped biomass for energy/board
primary_transformation: Sorting; grading by culm quality; hand-tying into standard bundles; baling for biomass
measurable_output: Volume graded to thatching quality (tonnes); bundle count; rejection rate (%)
output_unit: tonnes thatching; bundle count; percent rejected
D_parameters: European thatching industry quality standards (60cm circumference bundles; 2.8m+ culms); DDBRA value chain guidelines
C_parameters: Thatching grade volume produced; bulk biomass volume; processing recovery rate; quality rejection rate
notes: 35% thatching grade; 65% bulk biomass; EUR 285/t thatching vs EUR 42/t bulk (6.8x differential); 8 processing facilities

physical_state_in: Graded reed products ready for domestic and export markets
physical_state_out: Reed products sold to thatching contractors; construction suppliers; energy biomass buyers
primary_transformation: Export documentation; thatching market sales; certification compliance (none yet exists)
typical_time_scale: Annual sales cycle; thatching orders September-November
measurable_output: Export volume (tonnes); export market price premium (%); certification status
D_parameters: No formal certification standard for reed yet; buyer audit requirements; UK and EU market sustainability criteria
C_parameters: Export volume achieved; certification standard established; premium markets accessed; market access score
notes: 49 kt thatching exports; 42% to UK; 35% Germany/Netherlands; no certification standard; market access score 0.42. PRIMARY BOTTLENECK.

physical_state_out: Revenue to seasonal workers and DDBRA conservation levy and rural employment
primary_transformation: Revenue distribution; DDBRA concession fee; conservation levy; rural employment income
measurable_output: Seasonal worker income (EUR/season); DDBRA concession revenue (EUR/yr); conservation reinvestment ratio
D_parameters: Revenue reporting requirements; DDBRA concession fee schedule; Romania labour law for seasonal workers
C_parameters: Seasonal income generated; DDBRA conservation funded; rural household dependency maintained
notes: EUR 1850/season per worker (4500 workers); EUR 3.2M/yr DDBRA concession; 18% conservation reinvestment
